verdict.rationale: Bolna's API quickstart documents placing an outbound phone call through the API, and its official CLI manages phone numbers and calls. Inbound handling is only a marketing claim, and phone-number provisioning is shown only for the CLI, not as an API endpoint. missing for 10: documented API endpoint for buying/provisioning phone numbers, documented API configuration for inbound call routing to agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision phone numbers and run both inbound and outbound calls through the platform's API

citations.quote: Make your first Voice AI call with the Bolna API — verify your key, get an agent, place a call, and fetch the transcript in about five minutes.
Go from an API key to a real phone call (with a transcript and recording) in four steps.
lets you manage agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches directly from your terminal
Power thousands of inbound and outbound calls every minute with human-like, multilingual intelligence
you can use your existing SIP trunk provider, your own phone numbers, and your own calling rates.
